## About
Complete Auto Reconditioning is Mike's mobile dent repair business, serving Charlotte NC and surrounding cities. We work on cars, trucks, and motorcycles, and the goal is simple: restore your vehicle back to the way it looked before it was bumped, scratched, or dented.
Paintless dent removal takes care of door dings, creases, minor dents and hail damage. We aim to repair the damage right the first time, costing you less than a body shop.
We're rated 5 from 110 Google reviews. One reviewer said Mike had a truck full of all necessary parts to fix a dent, and another said you'd never know the dent was ever there.

## Services
- Paintless Dent Removal: Door dings, creases and minor dents pulled out without repainting the panel.
- Hail Damage Repair: Hail dents worked out panel by panel. We work with all major insurance companies.
- Scratch Removal & Touch Up: Scratches, scuffs and chips cleaned up so the paint looks right again.
- Headlight Restoration: Cloudy headlights brought back to clear.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to bring my car to you?
A: No. This is a mobile service covering Charlotte NC and surrounding cities, so Mike comes to you.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Email or text the year, make and model of your vehicle along with photos of the damage, or fill out the Dent Estimator form on the site.

Q: Can you work with my insurance on hail damage?
A: Yes. For hail damage repair, we work with all major insurance companies.
